# #2520: Patch (part 19 of 19): delete the dead files and archives nothing reads
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Part 19 of #2497 (deletions only, no logic change). Delete the tracked files that are dead or archives by `.github/hygiene/files.md`, sections 1 and 2, word for word. Read it first; its list of files that look dead but are not is included. Edit no file.

- **Only non-source files.** Every `.rs`, `.ts` and `.tsx` file belongs to another part of #2497, each compacting comments in its own files, so delete none. List a dead one, with its evidence, in your final message for #2497's reconcile.
- **A cited file stays.** This part cannot drop a citation, so a file any tracked file cites, by path or by name, stays. If that citation is its only reader, name it in your final message.
- **Never delete** anything under `spec/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, `crates/cards/patches/`, `crates/engine/tests/golden/`, `crates/server/migrations/` or `apps/web/src/wire/`. Nor `catalog.json`, `SPEC.md`, `BUILD.md`, `REVIEW.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md`, or the designer's source notes (`JackiOh_*.md`, `ARCHITECTURE-CCG.md`, `docs/*-set.md`, `docs/classic-sets.md`). Nor any `package.json`, lockfile, `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs`, build or test config (`*.config.*`, `tsconfig*.json`, `rustfmt.toml`, `clippy.toml`, `rust-toolchain.toml`, `.cargo/`), `scripts/`, `vercel.json` or `render.yaml`.
- **The hygiene issue.** This run cannot see whether this week's hygiene issue is open. A file both remove merges cleanly, so delete by the rules.
- **Look first at** `reviews/` (keep the review of a milestone whose gate is still open, and `reviews/2026-10-14-issue-814-first-pass.md`, which CLAUDE.md cites), `docs/polish/`, `docs/v0.3.0/research/`, `docs/v0.4.0/`, `training/` and `analysis/`.

**Evidence**, per file:
- `git grep -nF '<path>'`, and `git grep -nwF` on its file name and on its stem;
- a look at what can read it: the workflows, the scripts, the `build.rs` files, `include_str!`, `import.meta.glob`, test globs, fixture macros and every `proven_in` in `spec/rulings/`.

**Checks:**
- `git status --porcelain` shows only deletions;
- `cargo jackioh spec check`;
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance`;
- the bot selftest: `cd bot && env -u HARNESS_HOME -u HARNESS_DRY_RUN python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`;
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, when a deleted file sat under `apps/`.

**Final message:**
- a table of every deleted file: its path, its size in bytes, and the commands you ran with what they printed;
- the dead source files and the comment-cited files you left;
- anything under `.github/`, `bot/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `.claude/` worth trimming, for a person.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-2497`, not `main` (fullsend).

Part of #2497, split by Night bot (`opus`, [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41066415581)).
